en.headline: Police arrest 75-year-old man over hammer damage and faeces at Tsui Ping North Estate
en.dek: A resident was detained after staff found five smashed windows and faeces on the door of a shared kitchen in Tsui Mei House this morning.
body: Police arrested a 75-year-old man surnamed Chan on suspicion of criminal damage after staff at Tsui Ping North Estate in Kwun Tong reported that five glass windows in a shared kitchen at Tsui Mei House had been smashed and the door smeared with faeces.

Officers responded to the report at about 8am on Saturday and later found a hammer in the man's unit on the fourth floor, where many elderly residents live. The Kwun Tong District Crime Squad is handling the case; no injuries were reported.

According to police and estate staff accounts, the damage was discovered during a routine patrol. Cleaners were later seen working in the corridor. The man remains in custody while investigations continue.

zh.headline: 觀塘翠屏北邨七旬翁被捕 涉鐵錘砸共用廚房五窗兼大門塗糞
zh.dek: 今早約八時屋邨職員發現翠楣樓共用廚房五道玻璃窗被毀及大門有糞便污漬，警方拘捕75歲陳姓男子並檢獲鐵錘。
body: 警方以涉嫌刑事毀壞拘捕一名75歲陳姓男子。觀塘翠屏北邨翠楣樓職員今早約八時報稱，大廈四樓一個共用廚房有五道玻璃窗被鐵錘砸毀，大門亦被塗上糞便污漬。
警員到場調查後，在同座一單位內拘捕該名男子，並檢獲一個鐵錘。現場主要住有長者，案件交由觀塘警區刑事調查隊跟進，暫無受傷報告。
據了解，污漬經清潔工人處理。警方正繼續調查事件動機及經過，被捕人現正被扣留。
